subject: Reserved-capacity proposal: conditional GPU-index pricing request
messages:
From: PulseAI Procurement <procurement@pulse.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 07 Sep 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Reserved capacity inquiry + indexation clause

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. PulseAI is preparing an internal proposal for a 12-month reserved capacity commitment to support our production inference needs for realtime summarization. Preliminary sizing suggests ~5k concurrent tokens/minute average, roughly equivalent to 90 A100-GPU-months sustained (we've normalized using your sizing template).

Procurement asks:
- 12 month committed term, monthly billing
- Target discount range: 25–35% off list for committed reserved units
- Because our product budget is capped, we need to include a GPU cost indexation clause: if underlying GPU market prices rise by more than 15% vs baseline at signing, we want the right to pause/terminate or have a true-up mechanism.

Can Redwood accept a conditional pricing approach (discount now + true-up if GPU market index moves materially)? If so, please share proposed wording and any limitations (notice windows, cap on true-up, or alternative mitigations like quarterly lookbacks).

I'm attaching our ROI workbook and estimated commitment. Happy to hop on a call with Karthik and your finance team.

Thanks,
Susan Park
Head of Procurement — PulseAI
procurement@pulse.ai
(Attachment: PulseAI_ROI_and_commit_request.xlsx)

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
To: PulseAI Procurement <procurement@pulse.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 07 Sep 2026 11:06:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Reserved capacity inquiry + indexation clause

Hi Susan —

Appreciate the clear ask and the ROI workbook, that helps a lot. Short answer: Redwood can negotiate a conditional pricing construct, but we need to align internal approvals on the trigger mechanics and caps.

High-level proposal I can put forward:
- 12 month reserved capacity for the 90 A100-equivalent GPU-months
- Upfront committed discount of 25% on the reserved SKU list price for the term
- GPU Indexation clause:
  - Baseline: GPU index price fixed at signing date (we reference the agreed index feed).
  - Trigger: if index rises >15% for two consecutive monthly reads, Redwood may initiate a true-up review.
  - Options during review: 1) Redwood adjusts pricing for new invoices going forward (true-up capped at +8% on top of contracted rate), or 2) PulseAI may opt for a termination right with 60 days notice and a pro-rated release fee.

This structure limits Redwood's exposure (capped true-up) while giving PulseAI protection if GPU market ruptures. Marcus, can you confirm finance comfort with the +8% cap and the 60-day termination fallback? Karthik, if you're ok, I can have legal draft Exhibit C language.

Cc'ing Laura for legal input on notice / contract wording.

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
priya_natarajan@redwoodinference.com
(Attachment: gpu-cost-indexation-spec.csv)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 07 Sep 2026 14:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Reserved capacity inquiry + indexation clause

Priya —

Thanks for the draft. Finance position: we can agree to a capped true-up but would prefer the cap at +10% rather than +8% given recent volatility and our own hedging limits. A few guardrails we need:
- True-up should be applied only prospectively (no retroactive invoices).
- Any termination right for the customer should include a one-time release fee equal to 20% of remaining committed monthly charges (to avoid opportunistic exits).
- We need the index source to be explicit (e.g., Bloomberg GPU spot index or agreed third-party feed).

If PulseAI insists on a smaller release fee, we can trade concession on cap (e.g., +8% cap + 15% release fee). Marcus

—Marcus Lin
Head of Finance, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Susan Park <susan.park@pulse.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 08 Sep 2026 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Reserved capacity inquiry + indexation clause

Susan —

Thanks for the workbook, and great to see PulseAI sizing. We're aligned on a pragmatic path forward. Two points from my side:
1) If PulseAI can commit to a 12-month term and sign within two weeks, Redwood can increase the upfront discount to 28% (conditional on the +10% true-up cap & 20% release fee Marcus suggested).
2) We'll include a quarterly review cadence with a dedicated SRE contact for performance tuning; that helps both sides optimize SKU mix and reduce true-up likelihood.

If this looks reasonable, we can circulate a redline for Exhibit C today and target signature the week of Sep 20.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Sales — Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com

From: Susan Park <susan.park@pulse.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Elliot Ramos <elliot.ramos@pulse.ai>
Date: Wed, 08 Sep 2026 11:44:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Reserved capacity inquiry + indexation clause

Karthik/Priya —

Thank you — the 28% is in range and the 2-week sign window is reasonable. A few asks from PulseAI procurement: please clarify the index source and compute the financial impact scenarios (+10% cap vs +8% cap with different release fees). I've asked Elliot to run the sensitivity model and we'll turn it around today.

Susan
(Attachment: PulseAI_ROI_and_commit_request_v2.xlsx)

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Sep 2026 10:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Reserved capacity inquiry + indexation clause

Team —

I've drafted Exhibit C language for a conditional pricing appendix and uploaded a redline for Exhibit C in the DocuSign link (see related_links). Key legal points included:
- Explicit index reference: we propose using the Redwood GPU Index (third-party aggregated feed) and publishing the baseline at signing.
- Notice & cure: Redwood must notify customer no later than 15 days after two consecutive monthly index breaches; PulseAI has 30 days to exercise termination or accept proposed true-up.
- Cap & fee: include Marcus' +10% cap and 20% release fee as the standard. If the customer requests the alternate (8% + 15% release fee), include as an optional redline.
- Audit & transparency: Redwood will provide index feed snapshots and calculation workpapers upon request (non-public).

If everyone is OK, I'll push the DocuSign envelope and include both option A (+10% cap +20% release fee) and option B (+8% cap +15% release fee) for PulseAI to mark.

Laura Bennett
General Counsel — Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
(Attachment: Redwood-proposed-exhibit-C-conditional-pricing.docx)

From: Elliot Ramos <elliot.ramos@pulse.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwoodinference.com>, Susan Park <susan.park@pulse.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Reserved capacity inquiry + indexation clause

Team —

Attached is a quick sensitivity: if baseline costs rise 20% over the year, PulseAI's total spend (after a 28% committed discount) increases by ~9% under option A (+10% cap) and ~6% under option B (+8% cap +15% release fee) assuming no termination. Given our budget constraints, we prefer option B but we'll accept option A if Redwood can move the release fee to 18% instead of 20%.

Next steps from PulseAI: unless Redwood pushes back, we plan to mark option B on the DocuSign redline tomorrow and request a 2-week signature turnaround.

Elliot Ramos
Finance — PulseAI
elliot.ramos@pulse.ai
(Attachment: PulseAI_ROI_and_commit_request_final.xlsx)
